wet_day_rule.evidence: The WGEN PAR PPRAIN source tests RAIN > 0.00; the same positive/zero split conditions dry/wet TMAX and SRAD in MSD. The legacy narrative also discusses a 0.01 inch wet-day threshold, reflecting the source data resolution; the target metric series has 48 positive values below 0.254 mm, so this difference is material and is explicitly resolved in favor of the fitting code's >0 test.

transition_rule.definition: For each day, classify its transition from the preceding chronological day and assign that transition to the current day's calendar month. Carry state across month/year boundaries, including Dec 31 -> Jan 1. The original WGEN PAR initializes the first prior state as dry.
transition_rule.pdw: P(wet today | dry yesterday) = dry_to_wet / (dry_to_dry + dry_to_wet)
transition_rule.pww: P(wet today | wet yesterday) = wet_to_wet / (wet_to_dry + wet_to_wet); it is cross-checked but not stored in this CLI layout.

monthly_date_rule: WeatherMan WGEN parameters are estimated on calendar-month basis; leap dates remain in February. Transitions are chronological over all train-only records.
standard_deviation_rule: Sample standard deviation, denominator n-1, matching the original WGEN PAR MSD procedure.
gamma_rule: Fit positive wet-day rainfall amounts within each calendar month. Compute y=ln(mean(x))-mean(ln(x)); use the Greenwood-Durand approximation alpha=(8.898919+9.05995*y+0.9775373*y^2)/(y*(17.79728+11.968477*y+y^2)); cap alpha at 0.998 when alpha >= 1. DSSAT WGEN derives beta=(RTOT/RNUM)/ALPHA.

known_limitations: The accessible official WeatherMan guide is legacy v3; no current-version parser execution is part of this task.

The original WGEN PAR code estimates precipitation and conditional statistics using a 365-day indexing layout and skips Feb 29; WeatherMan's DSSAT adaptation estimates parameters by calendar month. This implementation follows the documented calendar-month adaptation and retains Feb 29 in February.
The original narrative describes wet days as at least 0.01 inch while the WGEN PAR fitting source tests RAIN > 0.00. For this candidate, the executable fitting condition is used and documented.
Angstrom, sunshine, instrument heights, growing season, and station QC thresholds are not inferred; non-WGEN metadata are explicitly missing where not supplied.
